predecessors.name: Twenty-second Dynasty of Egypt
predecessors.text: Upper Egypt with Thebes and Herakleopolis; 'more or less an offshoot of the Twenty-second Dynasty'

successors.name: Kingdom of Kush
successors.text: Thebes and Upper Egypt, which Kashta and Piye of Kush take: 'Piankhy, king of Napata, put an end to the so-called Libyan anarchy'

successors.name: Twenty-fourth Dynasty of Egypt
successors.text: no land named: the 23rd Dynasty page's infobox says only 'Succeeded by Twenty-fourth Dynasty of Egypt'

ledger.x: 837: the Twenty-third Dynasty is established in Upper Egypt.
728: Piye of Kush takes Upper Egypt.

wars.name: Theban civil war of Takelot II
wars.outcome: Resolved in Year 39 of Shoshenq III; Osorkon III rules Upper Egypt including Thebes 798-769.

wars.name: Piye's conquest of Egypt
wars.outcome: Kushite victory over Peftjaubast of Herakleopolis, Nimlot of Hermopolis, Iuput II of Leontopolis, Tefnakht of Sais and Osorkon IV; the Twenty-fifth Dynasty follows.

certainty.note: The pages describe towns and kings, not frontiers; the Thebes/Herakleopolis and Delta lines are approximate.
